svg.text: Push each module into the top half so every pin has its own column. The module body sits over the rails. USB cable still in the bag.
One column of five holes is one wire inside the board.
Each rail (+ or −) is one wire from end to end.
The groove keeps the top half apart from the bottom.

Press each module in firmly and evenly; it takes more force than you expect. Pins in row j, one pin per column. The bodies hang over the top edge and cover the top rails, which is why power uses the bottom rails.
board turned so P1 faces the
pin 1 at the left end of P1.
the rails: follow the printed red
and blue lines on your own board;
